**A.** A court would not enforce the bar against the assignment of the right to receive the $30,000, because a general ban on assigning "the contract or any of its terms" is read as not reaching payment rights unless it specifically says so. The assignment would still be effective, though the center could have a claim against the distributor for breaching the no-assignment promise. The question doesn't say whether the contract's language mentions payment rights specifically, so this assumes it does not.

CONFIDENCE: 75
